brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
A prominent Zimbabwean preacher has been arrested on sexual assault allegations. [1]
Namib Minerals has revived Zimbabwe's Redwing mine with its first gold pour. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR ZIMBABWE
The arrest of a prominent preacher on sexual assault allegations may affect public trust in religious institutions in Zimbabwe. [1][E1]

KEY RISKS
Zimbabwe is linked to 21 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, as of Nov 24, 2026. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether Uebert Angel will continue to cooperate with Zimbabwe authorities as he denies 'doom' warnings. [4]
